exposure: TGE people assigned female or intersex at birth
outcome: Pregnancy outcomes (live birth, miscarriage, abortion, stillbirth, ectopic pregnancy, ongoing pregnancy)
cohort: 1,694 transgender, nonbinary, and gender-expansive (TGE) people assigned female or intersex at birth in the United States
finding: Among TGE people assigned female or intersex at birth in the United States, 12% had experienced pregnancy, with varying outcomes and a significant proportion of unintended pregnancies, highlighting the need for gender-affirming reproductive healthcare.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery for 23% of live births among the participants.
